newsitem.title: USA: Kraft launches DiGiorno pizza product in Northeast.
newsitem.headline: Kraft launches DiGiorno pizza product in Northeast.

text.p: Kraft Pizza Co has launched its DiGiorno Rising Crust Pizza in the U.S. Northeast, completing nationwide distribution for the product that was introduced in February 1996.
Kraft Pizza, which is part of the Kraft Food division of Philip Morris Cos Inc, said the product expansion will be supported in the Northeast with an aggressive advertising campaign.

Kraft said the new product is aimed at capturing a larger share of the $26 billion U.S. pizza market, while helping to build the $1.8 billion frozen pizza category. First year sales for DiGiorno Rising Crust Pizza were $125 million, Kraft said.
